temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia is more withdrawn than usual during shifts; when Jose asks, she says it is nothing really, just personal stuff, and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant and outgoing at work; Jose has no specific reason to think something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jose moves from remembering her usual vibrancy to suspecting she is troubled by personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia seems to be dealing with personal problems she is not ready to discuss.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to listen and support her without pushing for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; she later confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing financial planning or budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has personal troubles, but Jose does not know the specific nature.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He learns the trouble includes financial stress and that she may accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially overwhelmed and could benefit from budgeting or financial planning support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and cautious hopefulness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to review budgeting tips together when she feels up to it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia tells Jose she did not think he was prying and is actually grateful for his offer to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worries he may have overstepped Patricia's boundaries by bringing up her finances.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His worry is corrected by her reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his support and does not see his offer as intrusive; he can help while respecting privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting her as a friend while being careful about boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is all good, plans a quiet weekend at home, and does not seek further help; Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle things privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and is dealing with financial or personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, partly. He notices she values his concern but wants privacy and independence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but likely prefers to manage her issues privately rather than discuss them in depth.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, acceptance, and mild uncertainty.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Remain available and check in lightly without intruding.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is pretty busy but handling it, thanks Jose for checking in, and says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia prefers privacy but appreciates his supportive presence; he should avoid pushing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her response confirms she is managing and values his low-pressure support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is busy but coping, and his continued supportive check-ins are welcome as long as they are not intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Supportive, reassured, and glad to be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular supportive check-ins and offer practical help, like coffee, without pressure.
